| TunerStudio label | Setting | Units | Range | Help (as TunerStudio shows it) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Idle control mode | `idleMode` | choice |  | See also idleRpmPid |
| TPS threshold | `idlePidDeactivationTpsThreshold` | % | 0 … 50 | Below this throttle position, the engine is considered idling. If you have an electronic throttle, this checks accelerator pedal position instead of throttle position, and should be set to 1-2%. |
| RPM upper limit | `idlePidRpmUpperLimit` | RPM | 0 … 1000 | How far above idle speed do we consider idling, i.e. coasting detection threshold. For example, if target = 800, this param = 200, then anything below 1000 RPM is considered idle. |
| RPM deadzone | `idlePidRpmDeadZone` | RPM | 0 … 800 | If the RPM closer to target than this value, disable closed loop idle correction to prevent oscillation |
| Max vehicle speed | `maxIdleVss` | {bitStringValue(velocityUnitsLabels | 0 … {useMetricOnInterface ? 0 : 0} | Above this speed, disable closed loop idle control. Set to 0 to disable (allow closed loop idle at any speed). |
| Idle modifier when in P or N | `idleParkNeutralOffset` | % | -100 … 100 | Signed idle position offset when Lua reports Park or Neutral via setParkNeutral(boolean). Negative values reduce opening, positive values increase it. Added to running open-loop idle, not target RPM. Zero disables the correction. |
| A/C adder | `acIdleExtraOffset` | % | 0 … 100 | Additional idle % while A/C is active |
| A/C RPM target | `acIdleRpmTarget` | RPM | 0 … 2000 | Idle target speed when A/C is enabled. Some cars need the extra speed to keep the AC efficient while idling. |
| Fan #1 adder | `fan1ExtraIdle` | % | 0 … 100 | Additional idle % when fan #1 is active |
| Fan #2 adder | `fan2ExtraIdle` | % | 0 … 100 | Additional idle % when fan #2 is active |
| P-factor | `idleRpmPid_pFactor` |  | -10000 … 10000 |  |
| I-factor | `idleRpmPid_iFactor` |  | -10000 … 10000 |  |
| D-factor | `idleRpmPid_dFactor` |  | -10000 … 10000 |  |
| Min | `idleRpmPid_minValue` |  | -30000 … 30000 | Output Min Duty Cycle |
| Max | `idleRpmPid_maxValue` |  | -30000 … 30000 | Output Max Duty Cycle |
| iTerm Min | `idlerpmpid_iTermMin` |  | -30000 … 30000 | iTerm min value |
| iTerm Max | `idlerpmpid_iTermMax` |  | -30000 … 30000 | iTerm max value |
| PID Extra for low RPM | `pidExtraForLowRpm` | % | 0 … 100 | Increases PID reaction for RPM<target by adding extra percent to PID-error |
| Use IAC PID Multiplier Table | `useIacPidMultTable` | choice |  | This flag allows to use a special 'PID Multiplier' table (0.0-1.0) to compensate for nonlinear nature of IAC-RPM controller |
| Separate idle ignition table | `useSeparateAdvanceForIdle` | choice |  | This activates a separate ignition timing table for idle conditions, this can help idle stability by using ignition retard and advance either side of the desired idle speed. Extra advance at low idle speeds will prevent stalling and extra retard at high idle speeds can help reduce engine power and slow the idle speed. |
| Use idle ignition table while coasting | `useIdleAdvanceWhileCoasting` | choice |  |  |
| Separate idle VE table | `useSeparateVeForIdle` | choice |  | This activates a separate fuel table for Idle, this allows fine tuning of the idle fuelling. |
| Override Idle VE table load axis | `idleVeOverrideMode` | choice |  | Allows you to change the default load axis used for the VE table, which is typically MAP (manifold absolute pressure). |
| Ramp target on return to idle | `idleReturnTargetRamp` | choice |  | When returning to idle from coasting, start the closed-loop RPM target elevated by the 'RPM upper limit' idle detection threshold, then ramp it down to the normal target over the 'Ramp target duration'. Helps prevent RPM from dipping below the idle target on return to idle. |
| Ramp target duration | `idleReturnTargetRampDuration` | seconds | 0.1 … 15 | Time for the idle RPM target to ramp down from the elevated return-to-idle value (normal target + 'RPM upper limit') to the normal target. Longer duration gives a gentler, slower settle to idle. Only used when 'Ramp target on return to idle' is enabled. |
| Separate idle tables for cranking taper | `useSeparateIdleTablesForCrankingTaper` | choice |  | This uses separate ignition timing and VE tables not only for idle conditions, also during the postcranking-to-idle taper transition (See also afterCrankingIACtaperDuration). |
| Separate coasting idle table | `useIacTableForCoasting` | choice |  | Override the IAC position during overrun conditions to help reduce engine breaking, this can be helpful for large engines in light weight cars or engines that have trouble returning to idle. |
| Dashpot coasting-to-idle Initial idle Adder | `iacByTpsTaper` | percent | 0 … 500 | This value is an added for base idle value. Idle Value added when coasting and transitioning into idle. |
| Dashpot coasting-to-idle Hold time | `iacByTpsHoldTime` | seconds | 0 … 25 | How long initial idle adder is held before starting to decay. |
| Dashpot coasting-to-idle Decay time | `iacByTpsDecayTime` | seconds | 0 … 25 | How long it takes to remove initial IAC adder to return to normal idle. |
